name: The Battleboars
summary: At Camp Narache, young tauren hunt battleboars to guard their lands and feed the tribe's youth.

sections.title: A Threat on the Border
sections.body: East of Red Cloud Mesa, Brambleblade Ravine lies in Bristleback quilboar hands. Tensions between the Shu'halo and the quilboar have grown into open war. The Bristlebacks train vicious battleboars to test tauren borders and trouble their old hunting grounds. Left unchecked, the beasts endanger game trails and Camp Narache alike.

sections.title: Feeding the Tribe
sections.body: Hunting keeps the tauren safe and feeds the tribe. Grull Hawkwind asks the young hunters to bring back the battleboars' snouts and flanks. Even these beasts, trained by quilboar hands, are put to use. Their meat and gristle go into stew for the tribe's youth, turning a quilboar weapon into food for the next generation of tauren defenders.

faq.q: Why are the battleboars attacking the mesa?
faq.answer: The Bristleback quilboar of Brambleblade Ravine have bred and trained the battleboars. They use the beasts to harass the tauren and push into Red Cloud Mesa's tribal hunting grounds.

faq.q: Who sends players on this hunt?
faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind, a hunter and elder at Camp Narache, directs young tauren in the final trials of their early training.
Battleboars roam near and within Brambleblade Ravine, east of Camp Narache on the eastern edge of Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: What happens to the meat collected from the boars?
faq.answer: The battleboars' flanks and snouts go back to Camp Narache for stew for the settlement's children and elders. The tauren use what they hunt.

faq.q: How does this quest fit into the local quilboar conflict?
faq.answer: The hunt introduces the open war between the tauren and the Bristleback tribe. Culling their war animals thins the beasts harassing tauren hunting grounds and sends a clear message to the Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine.
The Hunt Continues comes first. Grull Hawkwind sends young hunters to learn the hunting grounds of Red Cloud Mesa.

angles.text: As a tauren, you defend the Earth Mother's territories and waste nothing taken in battle. The Bristlebacks' war beasts become food for the camp's calves.
As a hunter, you learn the difference between natural wildlife and beasts the Bristlebacks have twisted into weapons of war.
As a cook, you know even coarse, tough meat can become a hearty stew that sustains the tribe.
